main_body: A small gnarled dead tree stump or root cluster in brown with a few green moss patches, drawn as a flat silhouette with near-black outline
top_band: none - the column at x=8 is a near-black outline row then a uniform brown (L~54-60) for the rest of the body; no lighter horizontal surface
evidence: The scan at x=4, x=8 and x=11 shows only dark outline rows and one brown tone (L~54-60) with a few green moss pixels. No lighter top band, no step, no front-edge line. style.evidence: Only 7 distinct colours and a median of 7 per tile, against about 108 for both references. 96% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is near-black, giving a sticker look. The body is essentially one brown tone with a few green dabs, about 2 shading steps against the references' 5-6 in the canopy and trunk. It has no canopy, leaf clumps or bark shading, and it is far thinner than the references.
